rejected_shortcuts: Padding-relative h<1 without normalization to the unpadded source.
Union rather than Cartesian composition of independent-component OR covers.
A short descriptor whose recursive consumer retains or rereads the parent source.
Hash-only merging at any tested fixed prefix length.

remaining_open_arrow: Derive on every ordinary CNF, from the P=NP assumption and one fixed clocked SAT machine, either a charged strict successor or a favorable charged typed epoch before any parent-scale SAT computation.
scope: These controls test necessary semantic, encoding, and exponent obligations. They are not a general SAT lower bound and do not prove P != NP.

fixed_hashes.interpretation: Distinct legal CNFs with opposite SAT values share each tested fixed SHA-256 prefix. A fixed digest may index a bucket, but exact reuse needs charged equality, semantic verification, or source replay. Increasing 4 to 6 or 8 hexadecimal digits only changes finite collision frequency.
fixed_hashes.status: FALSIFIED/RETIRED for hash-only semantic merging at the tested fixed lengths

independent_products.interpretation: Independent conjunctions combine exact OR covers by a Cartesian product, not by a union. At the (1/3,2/3) per-component point, the naive two-component product has aggregate exponent 4/3. This rejects one composition rule, not all possible global compilers.
independent_products.status: PROVED/EXACT for componentwise disjunctive composition; arbitrary compiler lower bound OPEN

malformed_encodings.interpretation: A verifier that treats malformed output as an empty or partially parsed CNF can turn an unused selector into a SAT branch. Generator collapse survives when malformed words are rejected and every unused leaf is mapped to a valid padded UNSAT encoding, as its definition intends.
malformed_encodings.status: PROVED/EXACT necessity of total strict decoding in the declared toy encoding; COMPUTATIONAL exhaustive check

padding.interpretation: If an M-bit core is explicitly padded to N=M^p, an N^h successor has core-relative exponent ph. Thus h<1 can be vacuous when ph>=1, and the padding construction/read cost must also be charged.

recurrence_edges.interpretation: Finite exponent elimination is exact for fixed machine constants K and sigma once h<1 and the shrinker exists. h=1 does not eliminate the inherited exponent. The direct (1,2/3) landing uses Fortnow's near-linear/sublinear-space endpoint, not the general product theorem. A mixed route must be checked against one valid endpoint, for example the phi product region, using the same realization.
recurrence_edges.status: PROVED/EXACT recurrence accounting; COMPUTATIONAL rational edge controls

horn_polarity_counterexample.interpretation: SAT is invariant under polarity renaming, but Horn membership need not be. A portfolio must rerun or transport its class certificate.

renaming.interpretation: Variable permutations and consistent polarity flips preserve SAT. Raw hashes are syntactic and cannot serve as semantic canonical names without a verified normalization or equality check.

source_carry.interpretation: A short handle plus a required M-bit parent is a typed source-backed state of exponent one. Expanding an M^b handle back to an M-bit child has scale 1/b, so the apparent contraction has round-trip product one and does not suppress an inherited solver exponent.

tractable_families.interpretation: Horn, 2-SAT, and affine systems are legitimate zero-recursive-child portfolio branches after charged recognition. Their correctness and syntactic diversity do not imply all-CNF coverage or a favorable general acquisition bound.
tractable_families.status: COMPUTATIONAL validation of exact tractable-family VALUE routes

surviving_claims: The explicit generator-shrinker equivalence survives when strict total parsing, valid UNSAT padding, self-contained circuit size, and charged construction are explicit.
Finite exponent elimination survives for fixed K and sigma once a genuine h<1 successor exists.
The typed Bellman route survives only with same-realization maxima, complete local weights, and strict endpoint slack.
